recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If further denormalization or 'never necessary' guidance is desired, handle it as a separate work-group-approved change with concrete wording in the appropriate SNOMED guidance or Extension Pack narrative source.
issue_request: FHIR-40724 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for Vocabulary. It requested adding coding-sctdescid contexts for CodeSystem.concept.display and ValueSet.expansion.contains.display, with discussion that any additional explanatory guidance would be better on the Using SNOMED CT with FHIR page.
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit directly mentions FHIR-40724. HL7/fhir-extensions commit 325987bdfa8e8191fcb4de32d57d3cd7152a5c19 added the two requested display contexts to input/definitions/datatypes/StructureDefinition-coding-sctdescid.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-33058 previously added the matching CodeSystem.concept.designation and ValueSet.expansion.contains.designation contexts. Current FHIR-core source contains the coding-sctdescid OID registration and historical generated extension copies, but not the live StructureDefinition source. The final Jira resolution did not approve concrete SNOMED guidance text beyond adding contexts.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined FHIR-core branch. No core source file was changed because the active extension source is maintained in the Extension Pack and already reflects the applied decision.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published issue broadened coding-sctdescid to the CodeSystem and ValueSet designation contexts that FHIR-40724 complemented with display contexts.
